# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run CI and issue-management jobs on `ubuntu-latest`. The Project half of the issue gate needs a classic PAT carrying the `project` scope, stored as secret `DSH_MEGA_PLUGINS_ISSUE_TOKEN`, and the repository variable `DSH_MEGA_PLUGINS_PROJECT_GATE` set to `true`; a GitHub App token and a fine-grained PAT cannot reach a Projects v2 board owned by a user account, which is what this repository has. `issue-lifecycle.yml` runs only under that switch and writes Issue comments with the job's own `github.token`; `issue-policy.yml` reads the board for `issues` events under the same switch and validates the event payload alone when it is off. The `verify-translation-pairing.yml` workflow fires only on README path changes. Dependabot labels dependency PRs `kind/dependency` + `area/infra` with a 30-day cooldown.
